title: Integration Config
description: Configuration of the external systems a product connects to (Jira, test management apps, StrictDoc, GitLab): how identifiers resolve to URLs and back, which adapter is used, which fields and statuses are written, and what the sync may write

requirement_source.description: The one requirement source for the product

systems.description: External systems; at least the requirement source

name.description: Local name of the system, referenced by product.external_refs

auth.description: Authentication; a service account by default

secret_ref.description: Environment variable or secret store key; never the secret itself

id_pattern.description: Regex an identifier of this system matches, e.g. ^(PAY|AUTH)-[0-9]+$ or ^(HLR|LLR|SYS)-[0-9.]+$

url_template.description: URL for an id; {id} is replaced, e.g. {base_url}/browse/{id} or {base_url}/{doc}.html#{id}

url_pattern.description: Regex extracting the id from a URL of this system; named group 'id'

document_map.description: StrictDoc only: UID prefix or document name to document path/HTML page, used to fill {doc}

project_keys.description: Jira only: project keys in scope

feature_issue_types.description: Jira only: issue types treated as features/requirements (Epic, Story, Feature)

defect_issue_type.description: Jira only: issue type for problem reports (Bug)

severity_to_priority.description: Jira priority name written for each problem-report severity. Defaults: critical Highest, major High, minor Medium, cosmetic Low

test.description: Issue type for dedicated per-test-case issues when test_backend is none

test_run.description: Issue type for dedicated run issues, if used

link_type.description: Issue link type from test to feature, e.g. 'tests'

fields.description: Jira custom field ids written by the sync; unset fields are not written

verification_status.description: Custom field id on the feature issue, e.g. customfield_10101

validation_status.description: Custom field id on the feature issue

coverage.description: Custom field id holding requirements-based coverage percent

test_lifecycle_status.description: Custom field on the test issue for test-case-main.status

latest_verdict.description: Custom field on the test issue for the latest verdict

baseline.description: Custom field holding the baseline id the status refers to

tcms_id.description: Custom field holding the TCMS record id, used to find the issue again

status_values.description: Jira option names for the five TCMS status values

milestone.description: How a test-plan maps to a Jira milestone

release_on_plan_complete.description: Mark the Fix Version released when the plan is complete

write_policy.description: Which writes the sync may perform; everything else is read-only

feature_fields.description: Allow writing custom fields on feature issues

feature_transitions.description: Allow workflow transitions on feature issues

dedicated_issues.description: Allow creating and updating TCMS-owned issues

transitions.description: Optional feature transitions per verification status

not_started.description: Workflow transition name applied to a feature when verification becomes 'not_started'

in_progress.description: Workflow transition name applied to a feature when verification becomes 'in_progress'

passed.description: Workflow transition name applied to a feature when verification becomes 'passed'

failed.description: Workflow transition name applied to a feature when verification becomes 'failed'

blocked.description: Workflow transition name applied to a feature when verification becomes 'blocked'

sync.description: How and as whom the sync runs

identity.description: Service account name shown in Jira

record_actor.description: Write the TCMS user who ran the sync into the Jira comment and the audit trail
